classification.difficultyReason: Use the diagonal as hypotenuse to find the rectangle's other side, then combine both dimensions in its perimeter.

content.prompt: Find $BA$ and the perimeter of the rectangle.

spec.description: Rectangle with diagonal AC. Redundant vertex letter D is omitted; its corner and right-angle mark remain.
spec.mathematics: BC=4sqrt(7), AC=2sqrt(35); right-angle marks at the upper-left and lower-right corners.
